channel.description: Latest articles from The Lawrence Times (lawrencekstimes.com)

item.title: Renovations to Kansas Union to include WWI memorial, game day watch spot and more
item.description: KU Memorial Unions have announced a renovation to the level four lobby and Jayhawk Ink space in the Kansas Union will include a WWI memorial, moveable furniture and a TV for game days. Continue reading ...

item.title: ‘Prevention is important’: Erin’s Law advocates seek child abuse education in Kansas schools
item.description: Advocates and survivors of child sexual abuse are urging legislators to pass Erin’s Law, which requires K-12 schools teach about body safety and sexual abuse prevention at an age-appropriate level once per school year. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence school board to consider tax incentive for downtown development, approving 2026-28 calendars
item.description: The Lawrence school board on Monday will consider approving a tax incentive for developments at the former Reuter buildings, multiyear district calendars for 2026-27 and 2027-28, and a 4.5% increase to preschool tuition. Continue reading ...

item.title: Person in critical condition after shooting at Hawks Pointe apartments in Lawrence; suspect in custody
item.description: A person is in critical condition following a shooting Friday afternoon in the Hawks Pointe apartment complex. Police say they have arrested a man who they suspect "went to an apartment, knocked on the door, then shot another man at the entrance." Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Public Library to close amid winter weather, plus other area closures and cancellations
item.description: The Lawrence Public Library will be closed Saturday as heavy snow is in the forecast for the area and most of the state. We'll add other closures here as we receive them. Continue reading ...

item.title: Winter storm soon to move into Lawrence; here’s info on shelter options, city streets and more
item.description: Several inches of snow, extreme cold and dangerous wind chills are en route to Lawrence. A cold weather advisory and winter storm warning will be in effect starting Friday evening. Continue reading ...

item.title: Six viruses detected at high levels in Lawrence wastewater
item.description: Six viral diseases — including COVID-19, the flu and norovirus — have been found at high concentrations in Lawrence wastewater as Kansas communities face peak flu season. Continue reading ...

item.title: City of Lawrence staff to propose new climate neutrality resolution
item.description: City of Lawrence staff will recommend commissioners repeal a 2020 renewable energy ordinance and instate a resolution aimed at attaining climate neutrality by 2050. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence advocates to host workshop on arts accessibility for blind and visually impaired people
item.description: The Audio-Reader Network will partner with area arts organizations to host the second Arts Accessibility Forum, aiming to promote accessibility at regional arts and culture events. Continue reading ...
